text: Every label has a definition and at least one positive and one negative example.
The guidelines say what to do when two labels both seem to apply.
Edge cases found during annotation are added to the guidelines within a week.
The guidelines state the intended use of the annotations.
Annotators can see the version history of the guidelines.
The guidelines fit on two pages.
Each rule is tied to an agreement measurement from a pilot.
The guidelines are available in the annotators' first language.
